title: Eight Apples and Bananas
transcription:
Eight Apples and
Bananas

I want to eat, I want to eat
Eight apples and bananas;
I want to eat, I want to eat
Eight apples and bananas.

(Change vowel on each repetition,
i.e. a hole to hit, etc)
notes: Draft song-level split from visual page transcription. Source page note: Draft visual transcription; small italic directions and playful spellings are uncertain.
